Sara (partnerships): Heads up — we're kicking off an SI immersive cohort for new systems integrator partners the week of May 10. Goal: get 6 SI firms through an end-to-end lab + capstone so they can self-run Redwood Dedicated + Marketplace listings. Quick sync? :spiral_calendar:
Ben (solutions): Love it. Need rough agenda and capacity. Willing to host 2 half-day lab sessions/week? :+1:
Priya (enablement): Draft agenda looks like: intro + infra patterns, marketplace listing + billing, HW kit setup (NVIDIA A100/80GB + drivers), canary deploys, runbooks, capstone. Each firm gets a mentor.
Carlos (field-eng): We should surface the HSM/KMS steps up front for regulated customers — that's a common blocker. Also include a short pre-req checklist for customer infra.
Akshay (training): Proposed cert: "SI Deployment Specialist" — 3 modules, hands-on lab for each, plus a final capstone where they deploy a private instance and pass an automated verification. Badge issued via LMS.
Sara (partnerships): @Akshay good. What's the pass criteria for the automated verification?
Akshay (training): Pass criteria draft: 1) private control plane talkback within 2m, 2) model pinned + canary rollback exercised, 3) end-to-end latency under configured SLO for 99th percentile in the lab traffic generator, 4) infra config matches security checklist. Tests are scripted.
Ben (solutions): Can we reuse the same lab harness we used for the marketplace POC? If yes, we cut time. Where is the repo?
Carlos (field-eng): Repo is internal: github.com/redwood-inference/si-labs (private). I'll add you. Lab harness has traffic generator + KV cache toggles.
Priya (enablement): Timing: cohort runs 4 weeks. Week 0 = onboarding + lab kit shipping (partners receiving HW). Weeks 1-3 = module labs + mentor office hours. Week 4 = capstone + certification day.
Sara (partnerships): Logistics question: who owns shipping & customs for HW kits? We have two partners who need DDP vs ex-works.
Ben (solutions): Partnership ops can cover DDP for tier-1 partners; otherwise invoice via partner contract. I'll confirm limits.
Priya (enablement): Training cadence: 2x office hours/week (Mon 11am PT, Thu 4pm PT), asynchronous slack channel for each firm, recorded labs. We should also create a short prompt set + eval harness to monitor quality regressions during their capstone.
Akshay (training): I'll own the eval harness. Suggest we use three benchmarks: latency, token-cost per convo, and semantic accuracy on 25 curated prompts.
IntegrationsBot: New cohort created: cohort-si-2026-q3. Enrollment link: https://console.redwood.ai/partners/enroll/cohort-si-2026-q3 (internal).
Carlos (field-eng): We need a playbook page for "Marketplace listing checklist" — includes metered billing fields, SKU mapping, and test purchase flow. I'll draft and ping @Ben for review.
Sara (partnerships): Add a short script for joint announcement readiness: partner PR approvals, co-branded blog draft, SOC2 line items we can quote. We want to avoid last-minute legal holdups.
Ben (solutions): For announcement gating: require signed MOU + quote of 90-day committed engagement or public listing opt-in. That prevents listing-only partners with no enablement.
Priya (enablement): Quick todo list: 1) Akshay: finalize cert rubric (due 1945009000). 2) Carlos: marketplace checklist draft (due 1945007600). 3) Ben: confirm HW shipping policy (due 1945006000). 4) Sara: partner invite & cohort schedule (sent by EOD).
Akshay (training): Noted. Will also add automated badge push to LMS via SCORM connector.
Sara (partnerships): One wrinkle — a hardware partner asked for a co-branded lab kit flyer. Who can mock that up?
Ben (solutions): I can get a quick one-pager from design. @Priya do you want partner logos on the flyer?
Priya (enablement): Yes but only after partner sign-off. We'll include a "powered by" line and link to marketplace listing.
Carlos (field-eng): Last note: can we add a firewall/NAT troubleshooting quick-runbook? It saves hours on day 1. I'll draft a 2-page "network checklist".
Sara (partnerships): Great. If everyone's aligned I'll post the cohort enrollment and kick off partner outreach tomorrow. :rocket:
Ben (solutions): :thumbsup: count us in for mentoring slots.
Priya (enablement): I'll schedule the first office hours and seed the slack channels.
Akshay (training): Will upload lab artifacts and test harness by EOD tomorrow.
Sara (partnerships): Perfect — thanks team. We'll reconvene 48h after outreach to review firm responses.
